references.text: The fifth commandment requires honoring father and mother, and Deuteronomy 27:16 pronounces a curse on anyone who dishonors them.
The law prescribes the death penalty for anyone who curses their father or mother, showing how serious it is to dishonor parents.
The command to fear father and mother repeats the importance of honoring parents.
Anyone who curses their father or mother must die – this emphasizes the same truth about dishonoring parents.
Proverbs warns that anyone who curses their father or mother will have their lamp extinguished in darkness.
A generation that curses its father and does not bless its mother is described as evil.
Ezekiel condemns those who dishonor father and mother in Jerusalem.
Jesus quotes the command to honor father and mother and criticizes the Pharisees for bypassing this command through their traditions.
Jesus refers to Moses' command to honor father and mother and condemns those who use religious excuses to avoid supporting their parents.
Paul quotes the command to honor father and mother as the first commandment with a promise.
